queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Grok Bot %' AND publisher = 'SpaceXAI';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Grok Bot %' AND publisher = 'SpaceXAI' AND version_compare(version, '0.75.8') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'grok bot.exe');
